attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2998/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Nothing in the corpus answers to this name. The page's whole notice is one sentence and a couplet, and it gives no year, no country and no monastery, so there is no `dates` object, no `office` and no `locations`; `venerable` is taken from the rank word «Όσιος» in the line and is the whole of what the folder claims beyond the name. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
